{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Replace -999.0 with NaN in biomarker_baseline
df['biomarker_baseline'] = df['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Calculate change in biomarker: final - baseline
df['biomarker_change'] = df['biomarker_final'] - df['biomarker_baseline']

# Drop rows where baseline is missing (now NaN)
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['biomarker_baseline'])

# Compute the average change in each arm
arm_change = df_clean.groupby('arm')['biomarker_change'].mean().round(2)

# Print the raw mean change for each arm
print("Average biomarker change by arm:")
print(arm_change)"}
